item.tib: zhi khro rgyu 'phrul drwa ba khro bo bde gshegs 'dus pa'i thugs sgrub me ri 'bar ba
item.coloph: ces khro bo bder gshegs yongs 'dus gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi thugs sgrab me ri 'bar ba 'di ni/ rje mtshungs med rig 'dzin gsang sngags grags pas bka'i nye bar bskul ba'i ngor/ thos chung kun grags pa bdag gi shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi nub phyogs su/ bstan 'dzin rgyal po chen po'i mnga' ris 'dus sde lhun grub dpag pa'i gling du me sbrul hor zla gnyis pa'i dkar phyogs su bgyis pa kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i rgyan du gyur cig//
